copy.tagline: 用 Appwrite 快速搭建后端服务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用 Appwrite 构建应用后端
copy.tagline_en: Build backend services quickly with Appwrite
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building an app backend with Appwrite

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会使用 Appwrite 的 SDK 来帮你搭建后端功能，比如用户登录、数据存储、文件上传和实时订阅。它会自动生成带权限控制的代码，并提醒你设置权限。
howto.when: 当你提到“Appwrite”、“TablesDB”、“node-appwrite”等关键词，或者要求实现用户认证、数据库操作、文件存储、服务器函数或实时功能时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Appwrite 创建一个用户注册和登录功能。
say.note: Claude 会生成客户端和服务端的认证代码。

say.text: 用 TablesDB 创建一个待办事项表，并设置权限。
say.note: Claude 会生成创建行、查询和权限设置的代码。

say.text: 上传文件到 Storage 并设置只允许用户自己读取。
say.note: Claude 会生成文件上传和权限代码。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will use Appwrite SDKs to help you build backend features like authentication, database operations, file storage, and realtime subscriptions. It generates permission-controlled code and reminds you to set permissions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'Appwrite', 'TablesDB', 'node-appwrite', or ask for user authentication, database CRUD, file storage, serverless functions, or realtime features.

say_en.text: Create a user registration and login with Appwrite.
say_en.note: Claude generates client and server auth code.

say_en.text: Create a todo table in TablesDB with permissions.
say_en.note: Claude generates create, query, and permission code.

say_en.text: Upload a file to Storage with user-only read permission.
say_en.note: Claude generates upload and permission code.
